checkpoint: Menu to casino floor to Sugar Lust to saved progress, one approved character, two presentation windows, and one Hot Streak claim

statusDefinitions.working: Executed successfully at the explicitly stated evidence level. Release acceptance is tracked separately.
statusDefinitions.incomplete: Implementation exists, but required behavior or acceptance evidence is unfinished.
statusDefinitions.planned: No integrated implementation was found for the intended player outcome.
statusDefinitions.blocked: The next required implementation or verification step has a concrete unmet dependency.
